floruit.note: Stated and never recorded, and the company already holds it. saint.gr gives the four of them one sentence, which this folder’s own life quotes: the confessors Agathon, Eutychia and Philippa «lived under the emperor Diocletian, whose reign it dates 284 to 305; they were arrested at Thessalonica in the year 304 and confessed Christ». `agathon-confessor-of-thessalonica` and `eutychia-confessor-of-thessalonica` carry floruit 304 off that same sentence; `floruit` and not `death` because the page makes them confessors and gives no death.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 16ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Αγάθων, Ευτυχία, Κασία και Φιλίππα οι Ομολογητές»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 16 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. Four names in one line, so four folders; the page's own heading calls her «Αγια Κασια η Ομολογητρια» and glosses her name not at all. It states one year, 304, for the arrest, and none for her; they were imprisoned and not killed, so there is no `dates` object. The corpus holds nobody of this name. The page prints no hymn and no couplet.
